phase_fractions — DRIVE pxrd op

• Data kinds: signal × signal × table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.phase_fractions(two_theta, intensity, dictionary, background_order=4, sigma=None, lattice_tolerance=0.0, phases=None) (to call the implementation directly, import pxrd; pxrd.phase_fractions(two_theta, intensity, dictionary, background_order=4, sigma=None, lattice_tolerance=0.0, phases=None); from the registry, opsdrive.get("phase_fractions"))

Usage

Phase fractions of a mixture by non-negative least squares (NNLS) (the background is fitted simultaneously with a Chebyshev polynomial).

y ≈ Σ sₚ Rₚ(2θ) + Σ cₖ Tₖ(2θ), sₚ >= 0, cₖ is sign-free (BVLS of scipy.optimize.lsq_linear). Volume fraction vₚ ∝ sₚ, weight fraction Wₚ ∝ sₚ ρₚ (see the module docstring). If sigma is passed, weights of 1/σ are applied. If lattice_tolerance > 0, the lattice scale of each phase is refined within 1 ± tolerance by golden-section coordinate descent (if the reference lattice constants and those of the sample differ, a reference whose peaks are half-shifted gets a lower scale and the fractions are biased —— see the trap gate). phases uses only some of the names in the dictionary.

Return value (dict): names, scale, volume_fraction, weight_fraction, lattice_scale, fit, background, residual, rwp (weighted relative residual), two_theta, wavelength.

Raises ValueError: length mismatch, mismatch between the dictionary's lattice and 2θ, negative background order, unknown phase name.
